answer: Weight each agent by random-walk trust over the graph of paid, completed jobs. Honest agents form a dense grove of real trades; a Sybil farm is an island linked to it by few edges, so walks started from seed agents rarely spiral into it and its fake identities share only the trust those few edges carry. To gain weight an attacker must buy real work from honest agents, paying per attack edge, while spawning more fakes adds nothing.
